push.title: W 3-2 vs JamRock  United | You: 9.2 (best match performance)
push.body:
buddskees, if I could bottle that 9.2, I'd sell it at every gas station from here to Wichita.

DID WELL
+ A brace against JamRock  United, your 2nd straight match scoring. That's a striker's instinct, and you can't teach that at a clinic.
+ Man of the Match, your 2nd for us. You were the best player on the pitch, and you know it. Now stay humble.
+ Highest rating yet: 9.2. History made.
+ 2.0 better than usual. Proud doesn't cover it.
+ A 9.2 ranks as your best match performance. That's who you are on a good day.

WORK ON
- Only 2 tackles attempted. Best practice: Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts. We'll drill it till it's dull.
- You and BellyTb1, same defensive work rate homework. Partners: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- 4 misplaced passes cost 0.1. Smarter choices fix it.
- Pass accuracy: 83%. Climb to 87%+ and you're top quarter.
- Passes attempted: 23. The good neighborhood starts at 25+.

Back-garden drill: When we lose it, press for 3-5 seconds right away. That's when they're most disorganized.

buddskees, here's what I'd tell my own kid: A coach's whistle is just a fancy way of saying 'I care.'

Keep doing you. You're doing great at it. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 3-2 vs JamRock  United | You: 8.8 (5th best match performance)
push.body:
An 8.8, BellyTb1. You were the steady hand on the wheel tonight.

DID WELL
+ 2 key passes (up from your usual 0). Assists don't make headlines, but they make teams.
+ A goal against JamRock  United. Ball in the net, smile on my face. That's the deal.
+ You & buddskees clicked. That partnership's got more legs than a centipede in a sack race.
+ 1.0 better than usual. The arrow is pointing straight up.
+ Your 5th best match performance (8.8). Keep stacking those.

WORK ON
- Only 1 tackle attempted. Fundamentals: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball. Mind over matter.
- 71% passing (17 of 24, down from your usual 79%). Try this: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too. Brick by brick.
- You and buddskees, same lesson: defensive work rate. Same answer: pass runners off and track them into the box.
- 3 shots off target: -0.1. Leaky faucet stuff. Small drips, big bill.
- Passes attempted: 24. Decent, but top-quarter midfielders get to 25+. That's the next rung.

Practice this: When the ball is lost, the nearest player presses and everyone else closes the passing lanes.

BellyTb1, my granddaddy told me this and now I'm telling you: Run like the ice cream truck just turned the corner.

On to the next one. - Coach Lasso

PhogsToffees, a 7.0 against JamRock  United. You were close to a good one. Let's find the missing piece.

+ 1 key pass. You turned nothing into something more than once.
+ You and buddskees had more chemistry than a high school lab.
+ 3-2 over JamRock  United. Winning's like a good porch swing: easy to get used to.

WORK ON
- 1 of 2 shots on target. Here's the trick: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. Little by little.
- 0.8 down on your average. Even the best hitters have 0-for-4 nights.
- A 7.0 ranks as your 6th worst match performance. Not who you are, just where you were tonight.
- Pass accuracy: 74%. 88%+ is where the magic lives.
- Shots: 2. Next target: 3+.

Work on: Set your feet first if you've got a half second. Off-balance shots fly into the stands.

Remember, PhogsToffees: Fall seven times, stand up eight, then ask for the ball.

Stay hungry, stay humble. - Coach Lasso
